messages.subject: Kingsmoor - contract, our counter-mark-up (v3)
messages.plaintextBody:
Dear Zoe,

Our counter attached, accepting your price/date/rate changes. On liability we've taken the cap to 100% of the purchase price, the notice period to 18 months and the de minimis to £10,000. We've inserted clause 9.3 providing for a £45,000 retention on the Aldermere rent review, released three months after completion less any amount attributable to the review. Subject to those, we should be close to agreement.

Regards,

James Osei
Senior Associate | Real Estate
Whitfield Carter LLP
22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ | +44 (0)20 7946 0500
